name: NucleDoom
tagline: The real Doom (1993) running inside Minecraft 1.21.4: shoot through the shareware episode or Freedoom on a giant map screen, with sound.
how_to_play: Play the real Doom (1993) inside Minecraft, drawn on a giant map screen in front of you, with sound.
Press Play to start Minecraft, then create a single-player world with cheats on.
Type /game open nucledoom:doom_shareware in chat (or nucledoom:freedoom1, nucledoom:freedoom2) and join the game it opens.
WASD move, Shift run, mouse look, left click shoot, right click use, 1-7 weapons.
F pause/menu, Space select, E accept, Q back.

notes: Minecraft: Java Edition only (runs on Minecraft 1.21.4, set up by SIGF). Doom shareware (Episode 1) and Freedoom come with the mod: no Doom purchase needed.
Sound is approximate. Beta: report bugs to the author (Patbox) on the upstream issue tracker. The author's public server playdoom.pb4.eu is a separate way to play, not part of this install.
